reason: Technical debt rising with AI generation volume is still supported. The RAMP study (arXiv 2608.25241, 441 repos) found commit velocity up 28-38% at every maturity level. Cognitive complexity rose about 53%, with static-analysis warnings up 1.7x, in agent-first repos without committed AI configuration, versus about 27% with it. The study is observational. Remedies are current: RMD-E10-001 (small PRs plus machine pre-checks), RMD-E09-001 (validated security gates), RMD-E04-001 (official scope boundaries) and RMD-E10-002 (committed AI configuration, added 2026-08-31). Mitigation in some repos does not make the global problem inactive.

evidence.summary: RAMP: complexity +53% vs +27% and warnings 1.7x without vs with committed AI config; observational.
